title: Vampire Vape Vlads VG Heisenberg No Ice 10ml
description: Heisenberg No Ice from Vampire Vape’s Vlads collection is based on Vampire Vape’s award-winning Heisenberg flavour: a mouth-watering combination of deeply dark and delicious berries and frosty menthol. This version dials up the fruit flavour while dialling down the menthol, for an e-liquid that’s intensely fruity but with a more subtle, cool menthol kiss on the exhale. Vampire Vapes’ new Vlads VG collection assembles some of the most iconic e-liquid flavours to come out of the legendary vape makers labs, and makes them available in high-VG, 10ml bottles. The collection includes such famous flavours as Heisenberg and Pinkman, as well as newer additions like Blue Gun, Loser and Attraction Fatal. Vampire Vapes’ Vlads VG e-liquids contain a 70VG/30PG ratio that makes them ideal for use in vape kits that use sub-ohm coils, as well as being easy to travel with. These kits include advanced vape kits as well as pod kits and refillable pods that use coils with a resistance of 0.8ohm or lower. Their High-VG content provides a deeply flavoursome experience with a smooth, comfortable throat hit and clouds of satisfying vaper! Based in Manchester, England Vampire Vape are one of the most popular and influential e-liquid brands in the UK. The company has won international renown for the quality and variety of their e-liquids, and for their signature flavours including such game-changing e-liquid icons as Heisenberg and Pinkman flavours.
